en.headline: Good Hope School withdraws Cantonese ban guideline after backlash
en.dek: The Clear Water Bay girls’ school fully retracted the Form Six graduation video guidance and apologised for the distress it caused.
body: Good Hope School on Monday evening fully and formally withdrew a guidance paper for next year’s Form Six graduation class video after it sparked widespread criticism for appearing to ban Cantonese.

In a public statement the school said it had never been its ethos to constrain any student’s mother tongue and remained dedicated to biliteracy and trilingualism. It acknowledged that the previous document caused distress among students, parents, alumnae and the wider community, and accepted full responsibility for the lapse.

Screenshots circulating earlier had stated that Cantonese was strictly forbidden in speaking, dialogue and voiceovers, with any detected Cantonese audio to be muted and reworked. The principal had already emailed students and parents to say the slides contained inappropriate wording that did not reflect school policy or actual graduation arrangements.

The Education Bureau had earlier urged the school to review event arrangements and maintain communication with stakeholders. The school said it would now work with student leaders, graduates and parent representatives to draw up new guidance.

zh.headline: 德望學校撤回禁粵語畢業短片指引並致歉
zh.dek: 校方公開承認文件引起不安，全面撤回指引，並強調尊重學生以母語表達。
body: 直資女校德望學校周一晚發表聲明，全面並正式撤回明年中六畢業班短片指引，就事件致歉。
校方表示，從不限制任何學生使用母語，兩文三語早已融入學校底蘊。校方承認先前文件引起學生、家長、校友及社會不安，對此負上全部責任。
早前流傳簡報指畢業短片嚴禁使用粵語，旁白須用英文或普通話配英文字幕，若發現粵語將靜音處理。校長早前已電郵學生及家長，指文件含不恰當字眼，並不反映校方政策或畢業禮實際安排。
教育局早前已促請校方檢視活動安排並與持份者保持溝通。校方表示將與學生領袖、應屆畢業生及家長代表重新制定指引。
